presets.name: Dialogue noise gate
presets.note: Lowers the room between words by 15 dB rather than shutting it off, so the joins are not heard.

presets.name: Gentle expander
presets.note: A light 2:1 expander that eases background noise down by up to 10 dB.

presets.name: Drum gate
presets.note: Closes fast between hits on a close drum microphone to cut spill from the rest of the kit.
